tutorial.first_clockin.title: Shift Started
tutorial.first_clockin.body: You're now on duty! Wait by your truck for dispatch calls. Use the dispatcher to clock out or invite a partner.
tutorial.first_incoming_call.title: Incoming Report
tutorial.first_incoming_call.body: Dispatch is sending you an animal report. Press E to accept or Backspace to reject. Missed calls count as complaints.
tutorial.first_call_decline.title: Report Declined
tutorial.first_call_decline.body: Declining or missing reports adds complaints. Too many complaints will temporarily suspend you from taking shifts.
tutorial.first_aggressive_job.title: Aggressive Animal
tutorial.first_aggressive_job.body: This animal is dangerous! Use your dart gun to tranquilize it, then bring your truck close and load it. Deliver to the shelter.
tutorial.first_stray_job.title: Stray Capture
tutorial.first_stray_job.body: This animal is loose and scared. Grab bait from your truck and place it nearby. Once the animal approaches, sneak up and calm it, then load it into your truck.
tutorial.first_wildlife_job.title: Wildlife Removal
tutorial.first_wildlife_job.body: A wild animal has been spotted in an urban area. Track it carefully, stay crouched to avoid spooking it, and tranquilize it with your dart gun. Then load and deliver to the shelter.
tutorial.first_deceased_job.title: Deceased Pickup
tutorial.first_deceased_job.body: A deceased animal has been reported. Collect the remains, then bring them back to your truck. No shelter delivery needed.
tutorial.first_tranq_hit.title: Animal Tranquilized
tutorial.first_tranq_hit.body: The animal is sedated. Bring your truck close and load the animal before it wakes up.
tutorial.first_bait_placed.title: Bait Placed
tutorial.first_bait_placed.body: Move away from the bait and wait. The animal will approach once it picks up the scent. Stay crouched to avoid spooking it.
tutorial.first_animal_loaded.title: Animal Loaded
tutorial.first_animal_loaded.body: The animal is secured in your truck. Follow the waypoint to the shelter to complete the delivery.
tutorial.first_shelter_delivery.title: Shelter Delivery
tutorial.first_shelter_delivery.body: You've delivered the animal to the shelter. Great work!
tutorial.first_timer_expired.title: Timer Expired
tutorial.first_timer_expired.body: You ran over time! Late finishes reduce your pay. Try to complete jobs before the timer runs out for full earnings.
tutorial.first_vehicle_damage.title: Vehicle Destroyed
tutorial.first_vehicle_damage.body: Your service vehicle was destroyed! You've been fined and received a complaint. Keep your truck safe.
tutorial.first_job_complete.title: Job Complete
tutorial.first_job_complete.body: Great work! You earned pay for that job. Complete more jobs to level up and unlock better pay multipliers.
tutorial.first_crew.title: Crew Partner
tutorial.first_crew.body: A partner joined your crew! You'll share calls and earn a co-op bonus. Both of you can work on the same job.
tutorial.first_level_up.title: Level Up!
tutorial.first_level_up.body: You've been promoted! Higher levels unlock better pay multipliers and increased tip chances.
